Staff briefings, friendly and clear
It explains what happens at the desk for everyone using the desk
Companion Animal Travel Desk

Welcome to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. We help travelers plan for pets with calm guidance, clear steps, and a focus on safe handling from the first check-in conversation to the final handoff.

When you stop by, the team will review your travel details, your pet's carrier, and any special care notes. We look for comfort, ventilation, and secure fittings so the animal can travel safely. A safety coordinator also reviews common hazards and the ways to prevent them, including stress, poor crate fit, and last-minute packing gaps.

If you are traveling with a cat, the desk will confirm carrier readiness and handling notes before the trip. <<FACT F061>> Please bring any needed paperwork and make sure the crate is clean, sturdy, and labeled in a simple, easy-to-read way.

For travelers with a small dog, the desk can explain the charge that applies and help you prepare the booking. <<FACT F056>> It is best to arrive with a leash, water, and a familiar blanket so the pet has a calmer start.

Reptile travel has its own age rule, and the desk will check that requirement during review. <<FACT F078>> We also look at the container, temperature needs, and any instructions tied to the species, because these details matter for a safe trip.

If you are unsure about what to pack, the team can walk you through the basics in plain language. That includes food, absorbent bedding, and any item that helps your pet settle without creating a mess or a distraction for other travelers. Softer carriers may work for some animals, while others need a firmer setup.

If something seems unclear, please speak with the desk before travel day so we can help you avoid delays. For more help, visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways or ask the front counter team to connect you with us.
